title: Part-Time Social Media Optimization Executive
behavioralFlags: No interview required
Asks to complete simple micro-tasks like liking digital media clips
Asks to move the conversation from WhatsApp to a VIP Telegram group
Gives small initial payouts (₹150) to build trust
financialTrap: Prepaid Merchant Task: Demands cash deposits (top-ups starting at ₹5,000) to clear a faked negative balance or unlock higher-paying task tiers.

title: Graduate Trainee / Software Engineer
behavioralFlags: Recruiter uses generic email domains (@gmail.com) or misspelled domain variations
Sends immediate PDF offer letters without structural interview technical rounds
Urgent pressure to accept within hours
financialTrap: Mandatory Security Deposit: Demands advance payments for background checks, corporate asset insurance, or laptop allocation fees (₹4,000 - ₹12,000) promised to be 'refundable'.

title: Work From Home Data Entry / Form Filler
behavioralFlags: Requires typing out text from images into a provided offline portal
Demands identity document scans immediately upon signup
Strict accuracy SLAs designed to be impossible to meet
financialTrap: Legal Extortion Trap: Scammers intentionally flag the completed work as 'low accuracy' and threaten legal court action for breach of contract unless the user pays a settlement fine (₹10,000 - ₹20,000).

title: Remote Optimization Task Assistant
behavioralFlags: Earn instant commissions daily by optimizing product ratings on partner platform
Work 1-2 hours daily from smartphone
Direct onboarding over Telegram/WhatsApp without interview
Gamified task progression
financialTrap: Requires user to deposit funds ('top-up') to clear dynamic negative balances and unlock high-tier commissions.

title: Virtual Package Inspector & Logistics Handler
behavioralFlags: Receive, inspect, and repackage high-end electronic consumer goods at residential address
Forward packages to international hubs using prepaid shipping labels
No formal interview required
High base pay for moving packages
financialTrap: Victim acts as a money/goods mule processing stolen items. Out-of-pocket shipping supplies are un-reimbursed, and bank accounts are flagged for fraudulent activity.

title: Data Entry Operator & Document Reviewer
behavioralFlags: Transcribe historical manuscripts and financial ledgers into digital text files
Extremely low barrier to entry with generic company profile
Mandatory orientation kit buy-in before project allocation
financialTrap: Forces the applicant to purchase proprietary software or training hardware from an approved portal before work begins. The seller disappears.

title: Secret Shopper & Hospitality Evaluator
behavioralFlags: Unsolicited job offer to evaluate customer service standards at local department stores
High advance payment checks mailed to residence
Instructs applicant to wire money to third-party vendor
financialTrap: Scammers send a fake check for ₹1,50,000, instructing you to deposit it, keep ₹25,000 as pay, and wire the remaining to a vendor. The check bounces days later, leaving you fully liable to the bank.

title: App Review Optimizer
behavioralFlags: Click to review applications per day to generate digital traffic metrics
Promises instant withdrawals of daily earnings
Group chat social pressure tactics with fake withdrawal receipts
financialTrap: App introduces a 'Combo App' which forces your balance negative. You must keep sending crypto/cash to recover your locked cash until you are fully drained.

title: Online Customer Support Representative
behavioralFlags: Respond to inbound chat inquiries regarding e-commerce shipments
Demands extensive personal details immediately upon registration
Background check requires custom untrusted link, OTP, and selfie holding ID
financialTrap: Requires full bank details, identity document copies, and selfie verification under the guise of an 'onboarding check', which is then used to open fraudulent credit lines.

title: Crypto Arbitrage Trader Assistant
behavioralFlags: Assist international investment fund manager by processing local transactions
Execute currency transfers on decentralized exchanges based on real-time market data
Using personal crypto or bank exchange accounts to handle third-party capital
financialTrap: Requires you to use your personal crypto/bank accounts to swap funds. The original money comes from victim exploits, rendering you criminally liable for money laundering.

title: Social Media Engagement Optimizer
behavioralFlags: Like, subscribe, and follow trending video accounts to help creators grow
Tiered subscription model for employment
VIP level upgrades required for high commissions
financialTrap: Locks your account payouts until you buy a higher 'VIP Level Tier' package using your own funds. Once paid, the system triggers a platform server error.

title: Virtual Medical Billing Assistant
behavioralFlags: Process medical invoices from home for flexible remote administration
Mandatory physical billing machine purchase or expensive proprietary software license
Promises of vendor reimbursement on first paycheck
financialTrap: Requires buying an expensive, proprietary billing software license and certificate course upfront. The course is a copy-pasted document and no real clients exist.

title: E-Commerce Order Processor
behavioralFlags: Help merchants clear global retail inventories by generating simulated purchase orders
Boost transaction volume metrics to earn high percentage tier commissions
Dashboard UI replicates real retailers with instant withdrawal lures
financialTrap: The simulated inventory requires out-of-pocket deposits to fund higher-valued virtual items. Once you deposit, withdrawals are blocked by fake tax fees.
